business.name: Northline Painting Co.
business.tagline: Rooms that feel finished, not rushed.
business.description: Northline Painting helps homeowners plan interior and exterior painting with a clear scope, careful preparation, and a finish that holds up to daily life. Start with the rooms or surfaces you want to change and the timing you have in mind.
business.offer: A site visit and a written scope before work begins

services.name: Interior painting
services.description: Careful preparation and a durable finish for walls, ceilings, trim, and doors.

decisionSupport.scope: Discuss the rooms, surfaces, current condition, and the finish you want before the scope is set.
decisionSupport.nextStep: A site visit confirms the preparation and the number of coats the surfaces need.
decisionSupport.preparation: Clear small items and note any repairs, stains, or areas that need special attention.

services.name: Exterior painting
services.description: Surface preparation and exterior coatings planned around the material and the weather.

decisionSupport.scope: Review the siding, trim, doors, and any areas showing peeling, cracking, or moisture.
decisionSupport.nextStep: The site visit confirms access, preparation, and the right coating system for the surface.
decisionSupport.preparation: Note any areas that leak, blister, or have been repaired recently.

services.name: Cabinet refinishing
services.description: A refreshed finish for kitchen and built-in cabinets without replacing the boxes.

decisionSupport.scope: Discuss the cabinet material, current finish, door style, and the color direction.
decisionSupport.nextStep: The team reviews the boxes, doors, and hardware before confirming the refinishing scope.
decisionSupport.preparation: Empty the cabinets and remove small hardware if the project is scheduled.

services.name: Color consultation
services.description: A practical color review for the room, the light, and the finishes already in place.

decisionSupport.scope: Share the room, the fixed finishes, and the mood you want the space to have.
decisionSupport.nextStep: The consultation narrows the palette and tests the colors in the actual light.
decisionSupport.preparation: Bring photos of the room and any fabrics, tiles, or wood samples you want to coordinate.

differentiators: A written scope before work begins
Preparation treated as part of the job
One crew from protection to final walkthrough

faqs.question: What is included in the estimate?
faqs.answer: The estimate names the surfaces, the preparation, the coating system, and the final walkthrough. Any repair work outside that scope is discussed before it is added.

faqs.question: How is service-area coverage confirmed?
faqs.answer: Share the full property address. The team will confirm current coverage and availability before scheduling a visit.

faqs.question: Do I need to move furniture?
faqs.answer: Small items should be cleared before the work starts. The crew protects the floors and larger furniture as part of the preparation.
